# Netflix Interview Guide

> The whole Netflix loop: process, coding, system design, behavioral, levels, and a question bank. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Guide pages

- [Netflix Behavioral Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/behavioral-interview.md): Netflix frames its behavioral interviews around a public culture memo, and interviewers ask questions that map to it directly.
- [Netflix Coding Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/coding-interview.md): The Netflix coding interview is commonly reported as a practical task of 45 to 60 minutes in a shared editor, at medium difficulty.
- [Common Mistakes in the Netflix Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/common-mistakes.md): Most failed Netflix loops are reported to fail on judgment, independence, or culture, not on algorithms.
- [Four-Week Plan for the Netflix Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/four-week-plan.md): Four weeks at 8 to 10 hours per week is a reasonable plan for an engineer who already works at mid or senior level.
- [Netflix Interview Process](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/interview-process.md): The Netflix software engineer interview is commonly reported as four main stages: a recruiter call, a hiring manager screen, a technical screen, and a virtual onsite loop of four to six interviews.
- [Netflix Software Engineer Levels](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/levels.md): Netflix engineer levels are commonly reported to run from L3 to L7.
- [Netflix Interview Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/question-bank.md): This page lists 54 practice questions for the Netflix loop: 24 coding, 16 system design, and 14 behavioral.
- [Netflix System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/netflix-interview-guide/blob/main/system-design-interview.md): System design is commonly reported as the largest technical part of the Netflix loop, and senior candidates often face it twice.
